records.statement: theorem sum_first_n_odd (n : ℕ) : (Finset.sum (Finset.filter Odd (Finset.range (n + n))) id) = n * n
records.proof:
induction n with
| zero => simp
| succ n ih =>
  have h_eq : n + 1 + (n + 1) = n + n + 2 := by omega
  rw [h_eq]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [ih]
  have h1 : ¬ Odd (n + n) := not_odd_double n
  have h2 : Odd (n + n + 1) := odd_double_plus_one n
  simp [h1, h2]
  ring

premises.type: {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] : Odd 1

premises.name: Odd.natCast
premises.type: {R : Type u_4} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) : Odd ↑n

premises.name: Nat.Even.sub_odd
premises.type: {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (hm : Even m) (hn : Odd n) : Odd (m - n)

premises.name: Nat.Odd.sub_even
premises.type: {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (hm : Odd m) (hn : Even n) : Odd (m - n)

premises.name: Odd.neg
premises.type: {α : Type u_2} [Ring α] {a : α} (hp : Odd a) : Odd (-a)

premises.name: List.sum_filter_bne_zero
premises.type: {M : Type u_4} [AddMonoid M] [BEq M] [LawfulBEq M] (l : List M) : (List.filter (fun x => x != 0) l).sum = l.sum

premises.name: Multiset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
premises.type: {M : Type u_5} [AddCommMonoid M] {s : Multiset M} (p : M → Prop) [DecidablePred p] : (Multiset.filter p s).sum + (Multiset.filter (fun a => ¬p a) s).sum = s.sum

premises.name: Finset.sum_filter_count_eq_countP
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (l : List ι) : ∑ x ∈ l.toFinset with p x, List.count x l = List.countP (fun b => decide (p b)) l

premises.name: Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ι → M) {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] : ∑ x ∈ Finset.subtype p s, f ↑x = ∑ x ∈ s with p x, f x
premises.doc: A sum over `s.subtype p` equals one over `{x ∈ s | p x}`.

premises.name: Finset.sum_filter
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [AddCommMonoid M] (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) : ∑ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∑ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 0

premises.name: Finset.sum_filter_ne_zero
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} (s : Finset ι) [(x : ι) → Decidable (f x ≠ 0)] : ∑ x ∈ s with f x ≠ 0, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f x

premises.name: Finset.sum_filter_of_ne
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0 → p x) : ∑ x ∈ s with p x, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f x

premises.name: Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [(x : ι) → Decidable ¬p x] (f : ι → M) : ∑ x ∈ s with p x, f x + ∑ x ∈ s with ¬p x, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f x

premises.name: Finset.sum_filter_not_add_sum_filter
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [(x : ι) → Decidable ¬p x] (f : ι → M) : ∑ x ∈ s with ¬p x, f x + ∑ x ∈ s with p x, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f x

premises.name: Finset.sum_fiberwise_eq_sum_filter
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] [DecidableEq κ] (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (g : ι → κ) (f : ι → M) : ∑ j ∈ t, ∑ i ∈ s with g i = j, f i = ∑ i ∈ s with g i ∈ t, f i

premises.name: Finset.sum_fiberwise_eq_sum_filter'
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] [DecidableEq κ] (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (g : ι → κ) (f : κ → M) : ∑ j ∈ t, ∑ i ∈ s with g i = j, f j = ∑ i ∈ s with g i ∈ t, f (g i)

premises.name: Finset.sum_filter_of_pairwise_eq_zero
premises.type: {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι} {g : ι → M} {n : κ} {I : Finset κ} (hn : n ∈ I) (hf : (↑I).Pairwise fun i j => f i = f j → g (f i) = 0) : ∑ j ∈ I with f j = f n, g (f j) = g (f n)
